== Notes ==
* Consider carefully whether to bring this skill. If it is used to resurrect a team member in the midst of battle, that member will have low health, requiring a follow-up heal. In addition, with no energy that member will likely not be able to join the battle quickly. In such situations, a non-reusable [[Resurrection Signet]] or a different resurrection skill is better. 
* Among all monk henchmen, currently only [[Taya]] has this skill.
